StaffProfile.Description: Staff master records with soft delete, photo, statutory IDs, banking, salary structure.

Attendance.Description: Daily presence marking with a same-day-only edit lock, auto-filled from approved Leave records, plus a monthly register view.

Leave.Description: Leave records with substitute arrangements — a permanent, searchable replacement for the WhatsApp leave notification format.

Payroll.Description: Monthly payroll runs — draft, publish, and generate the IOB bank CSVs and wage statement PDF.

Dashboard.Description: At-a-glance overview: staff composition, payroll cost trend, EPF/ESIC enrollment, leave activity, and recent changes across the system.

Admin.Description: RBAC foundation — role groups, user accounts, and local-credential fallback login.

IdentityProvider.Description: Current Entra ID configuration display, a config-snippet generator, and setup instructions. Grouped under Administration alongside Access Management.

AuditLog.Description: Searchable, filterable record of system activity - sign-ins, role changes, account changes, and other tracked actions. Grouped under Administration.

AutomationRules.Description: Global-Admin-only definitions tying human-readable names to Entra groups, applied during staff onboarding/offboarding. Grouped under Administration.
